decisions.reason: Premium support reinforces the firm's core differentiator of round-the-clock expert service for agencies and generates recurring extra revenue at low incremental cost.

The version management tool is integrated into the hosting platform and reduces developers' recurring work, though it was not observed in 2020 to 2021, so some risk of it being folded into other tooling remains.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business and GDPR novelty demand has faded, but it is cheap to maintain and supports customer compliance, so it is likely kept for now.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship product line and sits at the centre of the firm's strategic direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
